dict.string: Yoru connects to your Pocket recorder over Bluetooth to bring its recordings in as meetings.
Yoru hears you through the microphone when you talk to him in the notch, and records it when you record a meeting.
Yoru records the sound of your calls and apps when you record a meeting.
Yoru reads your calendar to notice when a meeting is about to start and ask whether to record it.
Yoru finds his board on your WiFi and talks to it.
